# opnsense_ipsec_key_pair (Resource)

Raw public/private key pairs for IPsec public key authentication (**VPN ▸ IPsec ▸ Key Pairs**).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_ipsec_key_pair" "site_b" {
  name       = "site-b"
  public_key = file("${path.module}/site-b.pub.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key pair.
- `public_key` (String) PEM public key.

### Optional

- `key_fingerprint` (String) Key fingerprint, read from the key.
- `key_size` (String) Key size, read from the key.
- `key_type` (String) Key type. Defaults to `rsa`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key. Leave unset for a peer key used only for verification.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the IPsec key pair.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_ipsec_key_pair using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_ipsec_key_pair.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_ipsec_key_pair using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_ipsec_key_pair.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
